headline: The storm shelter cut the crew's dose in half: 9 mSv each instead of 20
why: On 11 November at 10:35 the dosimeters saw the radiation rising (Cockpit, Crew seats, Exercise area, Hygiene bay).
Every astronaut was in the storm shelter within 1 minute(s) and stayed there 42 hours.
14 days in space gave each astronaut 9 mSv, like 4 years of natural radiation on Earth, 4% of the monthly allowance.
